# All closed Apple issues: exhaustive evidence and parity audit

## Scope and result

**801 of 801 closed, non-pull-request issues** in [kiwix/kiwix-apple](https://github.com/kiwix/kiwix-apple/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed), spanning issue creation **2016-01-16 through 2026-10-26**, are classified below. This is all closed history, not a recent/sample audit. Every available issue body and every fetched issue-comment body was reviewed in full with structured machine assistance; blank source bodies were not invented. Relevant closure timelines, actual linked patches, PR discussion, inline comments and submitted-review bodies were also retained and analyzed.

**This is an audit, not a claim of a completed feature superset.** Verdict totals: 19 **missing**; 144 **not-a-fix**; 432 **partial**; 29 **source-covered**; 177 **upstream-only**. No row is audit-time runtime-verified. No app builds, tests, linters, formatters, simulators, hardware permission grants, VoiceOver runs or runtime checks were executed by this worker. Existing project evidence and source inspection are distinguished from execution; in particular, no current iOS launch was supplied to this audit.

Owned deliverables are this report and [the self-contained raw evidence](apple-all-closed-issues.raw.json.xz). The original [Apple source audit](apple-source-audit.md) remains unchanged. The companion [all closed Apple PR audit](apple-all-closed-prs.md) owns the independent 919-PR inventory and wider PR conclusions. No application/reference code, shared issue report or changelog was edited here.

Final source/evidence snapshot: **2026-10-29T18:12:45.500486+00:00**. Search and iOS integration changed under other owners during this audit; later observations explicitly supersede earlier findings. Prefer named functions to line numbers when concurrent edits move code.

### Do not turn historical closure into current functionality

- **Live Activities / Dynamic Island (#491, #1037):** #1096 added them; #1130 disabled; #1134 restored; #1172 disabled again; #1181/#1186 removed the integration. No ActivityKit implementation in Tauri is a fact, but it is **not a current Apple parity loss**. Honest in-app background/suspended progress still matters.
- **Legacy service-worker replay (#290/#341/#342):** duplicate/deferred closure, then anticipation of Zimit 2, not delivered support. The transferred current safeguard is warning about unsupported archives (#362), not an imaginary working replay engine.
- **No-bug or provisional closures:** e.g. #1752 was explicitly checked and called “no bug”; #156 closed based on Files-app inference without USB hardware testing; #181 explicitly took no action; #520 split remaining work into other tickets. Their acceptance cannot be inferred from `state=closed`.
- **Closed-unmerged PRs are not fixes.** Examples include #526, #768, #1058, #1421 and #1784; later merged replacements are named separately where applicable.
- **Actual patches override titles/descriptions.** #1704 did not contain the sanitization; #1705 did. #1795's malformed OPDS-id patch is catch-and-skip around adding a nil UUID, not the two guards promised in its body. #1217 did not implement startup-fetch suppression despite the initial issue-summary interpretation. #1786 boots an available simulator and uninstalls the app, not a newly erased/recreated simulator.

## Verdicts and how to read the inventory

- **source-covered**: the specified control/capability is reachable in inspected implementation; exact fixture/platform/runtime acceptance is still pending.
- **partial**: related source exists, but exact requested behavior, platform integration, current-upstream correspondence or acceptance is incomplete/unestablished. This is not a softened “fixed”.
- **missing**: a concrete described behavior is absent from inspected source/evidence; a historical migration/custom-app request may still require an explicit product-scope decision rather than silently disappearing.
- **upstream-only**: an old architecture, withdrawn feature, build/dependency/docs/release process or upstream-specific operational task; no automatic runtime transfer is claimed. Its stated operational acceptance remains recorded.
- **not-a-fix**: duplicate/support/unreproduced/no-action/no-bug closure or a never-delivered historical request. The row still records relevant current risks/acceptance.

Each row names an **inspection area**, not a blanket proof that all functionality in that area is correct. Precise source controls and caveats appear in the current-gap cell and raw classification. Historical linked-diff/review caveats take precedence over any broader issue-title or maintainer “fixed” statement. The raw artifact preserves the full caveats; selected significant corrections also appear directly below.
